questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Physical Sciences Paper 1 · Question 4.2

State Le Chatelier's principle in words.
acceptableAnswers: When a system at equilibrium is disturbed, the system shifts to partially counteract the disturbance
The system opposes the change applied to it
questions.explanation: Le Chatelier: a system at equilibrium responds to oppose the imposed change.
